verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a government company-incorporation e-service: forms, digital signing, payment and registration. User-configurable background automations are outside this product type's axis. The automatic pact-document generation and email notifications in the evidence are fixed steps of the service, not automations a user sets up, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
